index.html.summary: AnyMotion API Reference Generated from the C# source under Assets/CodeSmile/AnyMotion/ in the AnyMotion-Development-Project repository. See the API Reference in the top navigation for generated type documentation. Barebones scope, 2026-08-11: only Core/Runtime/{Noise,SaveLoad,Presets} is documented here — the self-contained subset of the public API that compiles without a Unity installation (this CI runner has none). Widening coverage to the rest of Assets/CodeSmile/AnyMotion/ needs either real Unity DLLs in CI or a larger stub UnityEngine/UnityEditor surface; see docfx/ApiSource/ApiSource.csproj.

reference/CodeSmile.AnyMotion.Core.Noise.title: Class NoiseMath | AnyMotion API Reference
reference/CodeSmile.AnyMotion.Core.Noise.summary: Class NoiseMath Pure, allocation-free noise and oscillator functions shared by every product. Rig-agnostic: takes and returns plain numbers only, so the same functions can drive a humanoid bone, a camera, or a machine part unmodified. See shake-noise-spec.md §2 and §4 for why this lives in Core and why per-axis 1D noise was chosen over a 3D/vector noise field. reference/CodeSmile.AnyMotion.Core.Noise.title: Class Trauma | AnyMotion API Reference
reference/CodeSmile.AnyMotion.Core.Noise.summary: Class Trauma Squared-decay burst model (Eiserloh's trauma model): a 0..1 value set by an event and decayed back to 0 over time, whose square is used as an amplitude multiplier so a burst starts strong and fades quickly rather than ramping up. Pure functions over plain floats — the caller owns the state, so any driver can add trauma without this type needing to know what a "driver" is. reference/CodeSmile.AnyMotion.Core.Prese.title: Class PresetAsset<T> | AnyMotion API Reference
reference/CodeSmile.AnyMotion.Core.Prese.summary: Class PresetAsset<T> Wraps one preset data type as a Unity asset. Unity's own asset serialization persists Data natively; no code here is needed for that. Text-based save/load — sharing a preset outside the project — is a separate concern handled by CodeSmile.AnyMotion.Core.SaveLoad, not by this class. reference/CodeSmile.AnyMotion.Core.SaveL.title: Class SaveSystem | AnyMotion API Reference
reference/CodeSmile.AnyMotion.Core.SaveL.summary: Class SaveSystem Default ISaveSystem. Wraps expected I/O and format failures into a Result rather than throwing, so callers never need a try/catch around Save or Load. Exceptions outside that expected set — eg a bug in a custom ITextSerializer — still propagate, because those are programming errors, not the external-input failures this exists to handle.
